name: Polymarket USD
oneLiner: PUSD is Polymarket's USDC-backed prediction-market account stablecoin on Polygon; minted when users deposit USDC and redeemable through the Polymarket app.
collateral: USDC and bridged USDC.e backing on Polygon used for Polymarket prediction-market account balances
pegMechanism: Minted when users deposit supported USDC into Polymarket rails and redeemable back to USDC through the Polymarket application flow

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Polygon block 91673086. The pUSD proxy implementation remained 0x6bbcef9f7ef3b6c592c99e0f206a0de94ad0925f and owner() remained Timelock 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c. The verified CollateralToken implementation defines wrap, unwrap, allowance-gated burn, role administration, and UUPS authorization but no blacklist, holder freeze, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, pause, or transfer-hook restriction. The immutable CollateralOnramp can pause new wrapping per collateral but cannot freeze existing pUSD balances. Circle can restrict reserve USDC, and the Timelock can replace pUSD logic; those are reserve and future-upgrade risks captured separately, not a current direct holder-blacklist mechanism.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Circle can freeze USDC or USDC.e held as pUSD backing and thereby impair wrapping or redemption, but that upstream authority cannot freeze existing pUSD balances. The separately reviewed UUPS owner makes transfers restrictable through future upgrades without creating a current blacklist function.

mintAuthority.summary: PUSD is a Polygon UUPS-proxy ERC-20 whose current wrapper-role contracts mint only against USDC/USDC.e or legacy position settlement, while three UUPS prediction-market modules hold the token's separate minter role and mint only against burned position claims in their current implementations. A 3-of-6 Safe controls all roles and upgrades through a custom 12-hour Timelock. PUSD does not create base USDC supply; inherits Circle mint authority.

controls.label: Polymarket CollateralOnramp (immutable, wrap-only mint path)
controls.capDescription: CollateralToken.wrap() accepts only USDC or USDC.e and transfers the same amount to the immutable vault before completing the mint.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88325248: onramp owner() = 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c (Timelock, 12h). EIP-1967 proxy slots both 0x0 — immutable. Onramp has pause admin (ABI includes pause/unpause) — modulesOrGuardsStatus=present for the pause surface. Cannot create base USDC. At block 90347258, token rolesOf(onramp) returned wrapper role 2. Verified source shows wrap() transfers supported collateral into the token before CollateralToken.wrap() moves it to the vault and mints 1:1.

controls.label: Polymarket CollateralOfframp
controls.evidence: At block 90347258, token rolesOf(offramp) returned wrapper role 2. The immutable verified contract exposes only unwrap(), which burns PUSD held by the token and releases supported collateral; it cannot call the token's wrap() or mint() entry points.

controls.label: Polymarket legacy CTF collateral adapter
controls.capDescription: Wraps only USDC.e returned by merging or redeeming legacy conditional-token positions and transfers the same amount into PUSD before minting.
controls.evidence: At block 90347258, token rolesOf(adapter) returned wrapper role 2. Verified source transfers realized USDC.e into the PUSD token and then calls wrap() for exactly that amount.

controls.label: Polymarket legacy NegRisk collateral adapter
controls.capDescription: Wraps only USDC.e returned by legacy neg-risk position conversion and transfers the same amount into PUSD before minting.
controls.evidence: At block 90347258, token rolesOf(adapter) returned wrapper role 2. Verified source transfers realized USDC.e into the PUSD token and then calls wrap() for exactly that amount.

controls.label: Polymarket BinaryModule
controls.capDescription: Current implementation mints only when merging a complete YES/NO pair or redeeming a resolved position, with the corresponding position claims burned.
controls.evidence: At block 90347258, token rolesOf(module) returned minter role 1, the EIP-1967 implementation was 0x492fec596ec347459e1ebe30b9245eb3b49b1bba, and owner() returned the 12-hour Timelock. Verified source burns the matched or resolved position claims whenever it mints PUSD.

controls.label: Polymarket NegRiskModule
controls.capDescription: Current implementation mints only when merging a complete neg-risk position set or redeeming resolved positions, with the corresponding claims burned.
controls.evidence: At block 90347258, token rolesOf(module) returned minter role 1, the EIP-1967 implementation was 0xa61e7ca374f721d5b9fd5b0fee6fb90f27d448d7, and owner() returned the 12-hour Timelock. Verified source burns the matched or resolved position claims whenever it mints PUSD.

controls.label: Polymarket CombinatorialModule
controls.capDescription: Current implementation mints only when compressing, merging, or redeeming position claims, with the corresponding position claims burned.
controls.evidence: At block 90347258, token rolesOf(module) returned minter role 1, the EIP-1967 implementation was 0xb529b2430d78868422c47934d9d61cc9d0c53dbb, and owner() returned the 12-hour Timelock. Verified source burns the relevant position claims whenever it mints PUSD.

controls.label: Polymarket governance Safe through 12-hour Timelock
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88325248: EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x6bbcef9f7ef3b6c592c99e0f206a0de94ad0925f (UUPS proxy). Proxy admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS upgrade controlled by owner). owner() = 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c (same Timelock, 12h). No separate proxy admin contract — upgrade gated by Timelock. At block 90347258, the Timelock's admin, proposer, executor, and canceller roleHolders() each returned only this Safe; minDelay() returned 43200. The Safe was 3-of-6 with no enabled modules, zero guard, and zero fallback handler. The Timelock can add token minters/wrappers and upgrade the token and all three minter modules.

review.evidence: At Polygon block 88325248: PUSD is a UUPS proxy (impl=0x6bbcef9f...) and Onramp is immutable. Both are owned by custom Timelock 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c. minDelay() = 43200s (12h, confirmed via selector 0xc63c4e9b). Prior blocker 'confirm admin/owner address' is resolved: Timelock is the sole admin of both token and onramp. At block 90347258, the complete RolesUpdated history and rolesOf() reads resolved four current wrapper-role holders (Onramp, Offramp, legacy CTF adapter, legacy NegRisk adapter) and three current minter-role holders (BinaryModule, NegRiskModule, CombinatorialModule). Current verified implementations bind wrapper minting to deposited USDC/USDC.e or legacy settlement and bind module minting to burned position claims. The same 3-of-6 Safe exclusively holds every Timelock role, can change token roles and UUPS implementations after 12 hours, and directly holds the onramp pause-admin role.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: PUSD is an application deposit receipt backed by supported USDC balances and redeemed through Polymarket rails.
